title: Pickup Truck Crashes Into Ditch Near McPherson and Del Mar
excerpt: A pickup truck crashed into a ditch near McPherson Road and Del Mar Boulevard in Laredo early Friday morning. Laredo Police officers were at the scene.
content:
A pickup truck crashed into a ditch near the intersection of McPherson Road and Del Mar Boulevard in Laredo early Friday morning, November 6, 2026.

Video from the scene shows the light-colored pickup stopped in a grassy median area with damage to its front end. Laredo Police Department officers were at the scene, with police vehicles' lights flashing nearby.

The circumstances surrounding the crash remain unclear, and no information regarding possible injuries has been reported.

Drivers in the area are advised to use caution while officers work the scene.

Sources: Hammrod News Laredo TX; Laredo Police Department.
